layout.body:
MATH 101 Calculus I
Topics: limits, derivatives, and integrals of single-variable functions for growth and area problems.
Participation: one weekly lecture and two discussion meetings each week.
Assessment: one problem set per month; midterm and final exams.
Prerequisite: Algebra II or equivalent.
Schedule: Mon. (lecture), Wed., Fri.
9:00–9:50 A.M. (in person).

questions.stem: What is most likely included in the Wednesday and Friday course meetings?

options.A: Presentations by the professor on new topics
options.B: Time for students to ask questions about their homework
options.D: Opportunities to connect with other math majors

questions.analysis: 解析： 课程描述中明确说明参与形式为“one weekly lecture and two discussion meetings each week”，并且课表显示周一为“lecture”，周三和周五为“in person”会议。因此，周三和周五的会议是“讨论会”（discussion meetings）。讨论会通常用于深化对讲座内容的理解、解决问题和答疑，最可能包括学生提问作业问题的时间。 选项分析： A. 教授讲授新主题，这更可能发生在周一的“lecture”中。 C. 讨论数学职业，文中未提及。 D. 与其他数学专业学生联系，文中未提及。

questions.stem: Which student would be unable to take MATH 101?

options.A: One who has not completed an algebra course
options.B: One who has not completed a geometry course
options.C: One who is in their first year of university
options.D: One who has a part-time job on weekday afternoons

questions.analysis: 解析： 课程描述中明确列出先修条件：“Prerequisite: Algebra II or equivalent.”，即需要完成代数II或同等课程。 选项分析： A. 未完成代数课程的学生不符合先修条件，因此无法选课。 B. 未完成几何课程，先修条件未提及几何。 C. 大学一年级学生，只要满足代数II的先修条件就可以选课。 D. 工作日有兼职，课程在上午，时间上不一定冲突。
